module_summary: Wishbone width adapter: registers master requests to the slave and slave responses back; for wider masters an FSM with priority encoder splits transfers into multiple slave cycles.

anchors.name: wbm_stb_i
anchors.why: Master strobe launching a registered slave access

anchors.name: wbm_cyc_i
anchors.why: Master bus cycle indication forwarded to slave cyc

anchors.name: wbm_adr_i
anchors.why: Master address, aligned and registered onto slave address

anchors.name: wbm_dat_i
anchors.why: Master write data, word-selected and registered toward slave

anchors.name: wbm_we_i
anchors.why: Read/write command forwarded as slave write enable

anchors.name: wbm_sel_i
anchors.why: Byte select lanes, also decoded to choose slave cycles

anchors.name: wbm_ack_o
anchors.why: Registered acknowledge to master from slave ack

anchors.name: wbm_dat_o
anchors.why: Registered read data returned to master

anchors.name: wbm_err_o
anchors.why: Registered error response to master

anchors.name: wbm_rty_o
anchors.why: Registered retry response to master

anchors.name: wbs_adr_o
anchors.why: Registered slave address output

anchors.name: wbs_dat_o
anchors.why: Registered slave write data output

anchors.name: wbs_stb_o
anchors.why: Registered slave strobe, cleared on slave response

anchors.name: wbs_cyc_o
anchors.why: Registered slave cycle signal

anchors.name: wbs_ack_i
anchors.why: Slave acknowledge ending the cycle and passed back to master

anchors.name: wbs_dat_i
anchors.why: Slave read data captured into master read data register

anchors.name: wbs_err_i
anchors.why: Slave error terminating cycle, forwarded to master

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/WAIT_ACK/PAUSE FSM for multi-cycle splitting; disabled at equal widths

anchors.name: cycle_mask_reg
anchors.why: Masks already-issued sub-words for priority encoder in split mode

anchors.name: current_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Sub-word index placing slave read data into master word

anchors.name: cycle_sel_valid
anchors.why: Encoder valid: another sub-word cycle remains

groups.name: Master-to-slave request register
groups.description: Registers master address, data, select, we, stb, cyc onto slave port

groups.name: Slave-to-master response register
groups.description: Captures slave ack/err/rty and read data back to master

groups.name: Width-split controller
groups.description: FSM and priority encoder sequencing sub-word cycles when master is wider
